confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors draw on Denver price averages near the July 2026 window. Cocktail and wine estimates are about 1.8 and 1.7 times the local draft beer price, cross-checked against Denver menu aggregates. Accommodation is a lower-confidence seasonal model estimate, not booking data.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors use Denver-specific prices, so no proxy city was needed. Accommodation reflects a broad major U.S. regional-city summer demand baseline.
